```{r load packages}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(igraph)
library(kableExtra)
library(webshot2)

options("encoding" = "UTF-8")
```

```{r load data}

main_data <- read_csv("data_ready.csv")
distance_data<- read.csv("output_df.csv", header = TRUE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
#check <- distance_data %>% dplyr::select(S2CF1.S2CF1, Gloss, IPAactual)
```

## Data

```{r summary data - full}

n_infants <- main_data %>% group_by(Subject, Language) %>% tally()
n_langs <- main_data %>% group_by(Language) %>% tally()
age_data <- main_data %>% summarise(mean_age = mean(Age),
                                     min_age = min(Age),
                                     max_age = max(Age),
                                     sd_age = sd(Age))

tokens_data <- n_infants %>% ungroup() %>% summarise(mean_tok = mean(n),
                                       min_tok = min(n),
                                       max_tok = max(n),
                                       sd_tok = sd(n))

types_data <- main_data %>% group_by(Subject, Gloss) %>% tally() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>% tally() %>% summarise(mean_typ = mean(n),
                                       min_typ = min(n),
                                       max_typ = max(n),
                                       sd_typ = sd(n))

types_tokens <- main_data %>% group_by(Gloss) %>% tally() %>%
  summarise(n_typ = length(Gloss),
            n_tok = sum(n)) 


```

```{r summary data - disyllables}

disyl_data <- main_data %>% filter(nsyl_target == 2)

types_tokens <- disyl_data %>% group_by(Gloss) %>% tally() %>%
  summarise(n_typ = length(Gloss),
            n_tok = sum(n)) 

mean_tok_disyl <- disyl_data %>% 
  group_by(Subject) %>% 
  tally()%>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  summarise(mean_tok = mean(n),
            sd_tok = sd(n))

mean_typ_disyl <- disyl_data %>% 
  group_by(Subject, Gloss) %>% 
  tally() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  summarise(mean_typ = mean(n),
            sd_typ = sd(n))

```

```{r table 1}

infants <- main_data %>% group_by(Language, Subject) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Language) %>% tally()

ages <- main_data %>% 
  group_by(Language) %>% 
  summarise(mean_age = mean(Age),
            sd_age = sd(Age)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Language)

n_typ <- main_data %>% group_by(Subject, Language, Gloss) %>% tally() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Language, Subject) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  summarise(mean_typ = mean(n),
            sd_typ = sd(n)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Language)

n_tok <- main_data %>% 
  group_by(Language,Subject) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  summarise(mean_tok = mean(n), 
            sd_tok = sd(n)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Language)

n_typ_disyl <- disyl_data %>% group_by(Subject, Language, Gloss) %>% tally() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Language, Subject) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  summarise(mean_typ_di = mean(n),
            sd_typ_di = sd(n)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Language)

n_tok_disyl <- disyl_data %>% 
  group_by(Language,Subject) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  summarise(mean_tok_di = mean(n), 
            sd_tok_di = sd(n)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Language)

Table1 <- cbind(infants, ages, n_typ, n_tok, n_typ_disyl, n_tok_disyl) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, ~round(., 2)) %>%
  mutate(sd_age = paste0("(", sd_age, ")"),
         sd_typ = paste0("(", sd_typ, ")"),
         sd_tok = paste0("(", sd_tok, ")"),
         sd_typ_di = paste0("(", sd_typ_di, ")"),
         sd_tok_di = paste0("(", sd_tok_di, ")")) %>%
  unite("Mean age (SD)", mean_age, sd_age, sep = " ") %>%
  unite("Mean word types (SD)", mean_typ, sd_typ, sep = " ") %>%
  unite("Mean word tokens (SD)", mean_tok, sd_tok, sep = " ") %>%
  unite("Mean word types (SD) (disyl. targets)", mean_typ_di, sd_typ_di, sep = " ") %>%
  unite("Mean word tokens (SD) (disyl. targets)", mean_tok_di, sd_tok_di, sep = " ") %>%
  rename("n infants" = n)

kable(Table1) %>% kable_styling("striped") %>% save_kable("Table1.pdf")
```

```{r syllable numbers - Table 2}

distance_data %>% filter(data_type == "actual" & nsyl_actual == 2)

distance_data %>% filter(data_type == "actual" & nsyl_actual == 2) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  summarise(n_disyl = sum(n),
            pc_disyl = n_disyl/1818)

prop_syls <- distance_data %>% filter(data_type == "actual") %>% 
  group_by(nsyl_actual) %>% 
  tally() %>%  
  mutate(prop = n/1818) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, ~round(., 2)) %>%
  rename("proportion" = prop) %>%
  dplyr::select(-n)

Table2 <- distance_data %>% filter(data_type == "actual") %>% 
  group_by(Language, nsyl_actual) %>% tally() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Language, values_from = n) %>%
  mutate_all(~replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>%
  left_join(prop_syls) %>%
  rename("n syllables" = nsyl_actual)

  
kable(Table2) %>% kable_styling("striped") %>% save_kable("Table2.pdf")

```

```{r ex of distance table}

Table3 <- distance_data %>% dplyr::select(Subject, Language, Gloss, IPAactual, 
                                S1C1.S1C1, #S1C2.S1C2, S1C3.S1C3, S1C4.S1C4,
                                S2C1.S2C1, #S2C2.S2C2, S2C3.S2C3, S2C4.S2C4,
                                SFC1.SFC1, #SFC2.SFC2, 
                                SFCF1.SFCF1, #SFCF2.SFCF2,
                                nsyl_actual, data_type
                                ) %>%
  filter(#S1C1.S1C1 != "0" &
           #nsyl_actual ==2 &
             data_type == "actual" & 
             Language == "UK") %>%
  group_by(Gloss) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  filter(Gloss %in% c("cuddle", "cookie", "phuppo", "eeyore", "flowers")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-nsyl_actual, -data_type) %>%
  rename("IPA" = IPAactual)

names(Table3) <- sub(".*\\.", "", names(Table3))
names(Table3)

kable(Table3) %>% kable_styling("striped") %>% save_kable("Table3.pdf")

```

```{r ex of distance table - geminates}
#set.seed(24)

Table4a <- distance_data %>%
  filter(
    geminate_T == T,
    data_type == "target") %>%
  group_by(Language, Gloss)  %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  mutate(`Data type` = ifelse(Subject == "Atte", "Target", "")
         ) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Data type`,Subject, Language, Gloss, IPAtarget,
                                S1C1.S1C1, #S1C2.S1C2, S1C3.S1C3, S1C4.S1C4,
                                S1CF1.S1CF1, S1CF2.S1CF2,
                                S2C1.S2C1, S2CF1.S2CF1, #S2C2.S2C2, S2C3.S2C3, S2C4.S2C4,
                                SFC1.SFC1, #SFC2.SFC2,
                                #SFCF1.SFCF1, SFCF2.SFCF2,
                                ) %>%
  filter(Gloss %in% c("ankka", "hot", "cookie", "phuppo")) %>%
  rename("IPA" = IPAtarget) %>%
  mutate(Gloss = fct_recode(Gloss,
                            "ankka 'duck'" = "ankka",
                            "kukki 'cookie'" = "cookie",
                            "atsui 'hot" = "hot",
                            "phuppo 'uncle'" = "phuppo"),
         )

names(Table4a) <- sub(".*\\.", "", names(Table4a))
names(Table4a)

Table4b <- distance_data %>%
  filter(
    geminate_A == T,
    data_type == "actual") %>%
  group_by(Language, Gloss)  %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  mutate(`Data type` = ifelse(Subject == "Mira", "Actual", "")
         ) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Data type`, Subject, Language, Gloss, IPAactual,
                                S1C1.S1C1, #S1C2.S1C2, S1C3.S1C3, S1C4.S1C4,
                                S1CF1.S1CF1, S1CF2.S1CF2,
                                S2C1.S2C1, S2CF1.S2CF1,#S2C2.S2C2, S2C3.S2C3, S2C4.S2C4,
                                SFC1.SFC1, #SFC2.SFC2,
                                #SFCF1.SFCF1, SFCF2.SFCF2
                                ) %>%
   filter(Gloss %in% c("häntä", "roska", "cassé", "Mummy")) %>%
   rename("IPA" = IPAactual) %>%
  mutate(Gloss = fct_recode(Gloss,
                            "häntä 'him'" = "häntä",
                            "roska 'rubbish'" = "roska",
                            "cassé 'broken" = "cassé"))

names(Table4b) <- sub(".*\\.", "", names(Table4b))
names(Table4b)

Table4 <- rbind(Table4a, Table4b)

kable(Table4) %>% kable_styling("striped") %>% save_kable("Table4.pdf")

```
